correctness.rationale: The Euclidean cluster lemma gives C⊆T and universal R(x)=T for all x in T without finiteness. Two inductions give twelve complete pointed truth signatures; all are realized in a five-world serial-root frame plus a one-world dead-end and isolated by six tests. Normality/additivity at the five-world root implies a finite union-preserving Boolean set function on its five singleton valuations, automorphisms reduce coefficients to three, and indistinguishable valuations {c1} vs {c1,u1} force gamma≤beta. This yields exactly the six serial patterns; the dead-end gives an independent binary choice. Twelve representatives are globally completely additive. The embedded executable independently exhausts 354 Euclidean frames up to size four and tests all 4096 signature truth tables; finite checks supplement rather than replace the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The motivating recent classification studies the exact class of normal additive one-variable modal interpretations but omits Euclidean K5. Identifying all twelve K5 unary modalities fills this naturally adjacent gap; the stronger collapse from binary additivity to complete additivity contrasts with known transitive-frame pathologies. The 4096 one-generated algebra cardinality is an exact natural algebraic invariant refining the established qualitative local tabularity, obtained structurally rather than by an arbitrary computational slice.
